title: Pressure to back promising AI startups is upending the VC investment process, with investors willing to buy into the same round at rapidly escalating valuations (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Pressure to back promising AI startups is upending the VC investment process, with investors willing to buy into the same round at rapidly escalating valuations — Venture capitalists are fighting to invest in AI startup Emulate, driving its valuation into the billions …
